headline: Northern Front Churns Under Heavy Assault in Weathered Expanse and Mooring
war_summary: Weathered Expanse continues to endure the fiercest fighting on the map, logging twelve strategic base transitions in the past two hours and sixty-three over the day, leaving three positions in no-man's-land while forces contest Wightwalk, Spirit Watch, and Shattered Advance. Heavy combat persists across Mooring County, where six base events occurred in the last two hours amid more than seven hundred casualties centered around Gravekeeper's Holdfast. In Callahan's Passage, ongoing clashes near Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage produced three fresh transitions over the two-hour span as casualty rates accelerated for both factions. Territorial movements along Nevish Line paused in the latest two-hour window, though clashes inflicted over six hundred casualties. Dead Lands witnessed a sharp surge of more than eight hundred combined casualties without shifting base control, while previously contested sectors such as Kuura Strand, Fisherman's Row, and Palantine Berm have stayed quiet.
